__NOTOC__{{NPC infobox | image= [[File:Ghostly Hero.png|150px]] | type = Ghost | profession = w | level = 24 | campaign = Nightfall | map1 = [[image:primeval_king_jahnus_location.jpg]] | map1-text = Location in The Shattered Ravines. }} [[Primeval King Jahnus]] is the spirit of one of the kings of ancient times, like those buried in the [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]]. ==Locations== *[[The Desolation]] **{{NPC location|The Shattered Ravines}} (not after completing [[Refuse the King]] or [[Destroy the Ungrateful Slaves]]) ==Quests== '''Quests given:''' *[[The Desolation]] **[[Refuse the King]] **[[Destroy the Ungrateful Slaves]] '''''Note''': These quests are mutually exclusive.'' ==Skills== {{section-stub}} *{{Skill icon|Cyclone Axe}} *{{Skill icon|Disrupting Chop}} *{{Skill icon|Swift Chop}} ==Dialogue== :''"You stand before a king, mortal [[creature]]! You will show respect if you wish to leave this meeting intact. The sound of my name makes the gods tremble from on high!

Show your allegiance and respect to King Jahnus and lend your assistance. A band of my former slaves are scheming my demise. I will not stand idle and await a second death. Will you lend me aid, ?"'' ==Notes== *The weapon he wields is a [[Chaos Axe]]. *He shares the same model as the [[Ghostly Hero]]es. ==See also== {{gw2w|Champion King Jahnus}} *[[Elonian royalty family tree]] [[Category:Ghosts]] [[Category:Primeval Kings]]
